overall: The AG found that two e-mails sent by former Board Chair Timothy Toomey to a quorum of the three-member Board deliberated on public business in violation of the OML, a violation by the Chair individually rather than the Board as a whole.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board Chair deliberated by e-mail. The Oct. 13, 2015 e-mail to the Treasurer and Administrator, copied to the quorum, raised water department financial matters.
allegations.key_passage: This constituted deliberation, and therefore the discussion should have taken place during an open meeting.

allegations.summary: The Oct. 14, 2015 follow-up e-mail forwarded the first message to the same recipients, including the other Board members, with a request to respond.
allegations.key_passage: By sending the latter e-mail, which included the text of the first e-mail, Chair Toomey further communicated to a quorum of the Board on matters within its jurisdiction.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law by the former Board Chair.
Release to the public, within 30 days of receipt of the letter, of the two e-mails referenced in the determination.
remedy_passage: We order Mr. Toomey's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. We also order that the Board release to the public, within 30 days following receipt of this letter, the two e-mails referenced herein.
